title: Estimote turned its sensor-based technology into a space management application for social distancing during the COVID-19 pandemic
problem_hook: At the height of the COVID-19 pandemic, Estimote required a space management application that would help organisations comply with social distancing guidelines and enable rapid contact tracing.
impact_statement: The Codest delivered the frontend and backend of a space management application that alerts employees to unsafe proximity and enables administrators to immediately identify close contacts.
about: Estimote, Inc. develops sensor-based technology that transforms how businesses interact with customers in physical spaces. Using Bluetooth Smart, its devices enable interaction between smartphones and real-world environments. The company is headquartered in New York.

paragraphs: The COVID-19 pandemic required organisations to maintain physical distancing in the workplace and to respond quickly to confirmed cases. Without a dedicated system, identifying close contacts and issuing quarantine notices was a slow, manual process.

Estimote's sensor technology could already measure the distance between individuals. The company required a complete space management application built on that technology, delivered within the timeframe of the pandemic response.

key_challenges.label: Time pressure
key_challenges.text: development and deployment had to be completed during the peak of the pandemic to meet immediate social distancing requirements.

key_challenges.label: Real-time monitoring
key_challenges.text: the system had to track interactions and distances between users in real time across large office spaces.

key_challenges.label: Scalability
key_challenges.text: the application had to scale efficiently as the number of users, devices and data points increased.

key_challenges.label: Data security
key_challenges.text: the application processed health-related data, requiring strong encryption, strict access controls and ongoing regulatory compliance.

challenge.stakes: Any delay in delivery would have reduced the application's value to organisations complying with social distancing guidelines during the pandemic.

stats_band.label: locations managed via a unified platform

project_description: Estimote partnered with The Codest to develop a space management application that helped organisations comply with social distancing guidelines. The application used sensors to measure the distance between employees and triggered an audible alert whenever two people came within two metres of each other. An integrated contact tracing system enabled administrators to immediately identify individuals who had been in proximity to a confirmed COVID-19 case, accelerating the issue of quarantine notices. The architecture was designed for high performance and real-time data processing across large user bases.
approach: The Codest was responsible for both frontend and backend development. On the frontend, we delivered a clear, intuitive interface that allows office managers and staff to operate the system without technical support.

The backend was engineered for scalability, supporting high volumes of real-time sensor data while maintaining consistent performance. Given the sensitivity of health data, we implemented strong encryption and strict access controls, supported by a programme of regular updates to maintain compliance with current regulations and health standards.
Development followed Estimote's wireframes and specifications, with transparent estimates provided for each stage of work.

results.summary: Estimote deployed its space management application during the peak of the pandemic, delivered in line with its specifications.
